+"""
+Loads image bytes from a value a user may have set (cut image_path,
+character image_url, style reference, ...).
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request to such a value. Only these
+sources are accepted:
+- data:image/...;base64,... URLs (decoded in-process)
+- relative object paths in our storage ("schema/id/file.png")
+- absolute URLs under settings.STORAGE_HOST, which are mapped back to their
+  relative path and read through the storage client (not over HTTP)
+Anything else (other hosts, other schemes, path traversal) returns None.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def _is_safe_object_path(path: str) -> bool:
+    if not path or path.startswith("/") or "\\" in path or "\x00" in path:
+        return False
+    if ":" in path.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        # looks like a scheme ("http:", "file:", "gopher:", ...)
+        return False
+    return all(segment not in ("", ".", "..") for segment in path.split("/"))
+
+
+def storage_path_from_source(source: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the relative storage path `source` points to, or None if it
+    does not point into our storage."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    parts = urlsplit(source)
+    if not parts.scheme and not parts.netloc:
+        path = source
+    else:
+        host = settings.STORAGE_HOST
+        if not host or parts.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https"):
+            return None
+        base = urlsplit(host)
+        if (parts.scheme.lower(), parts.netloc.lower()) != (base.scheme.lower(), base.netloc.lower()):
+            return None
+        if parts.query or parts.fragment or parts.username or parts.password:
+            return None
+        prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        if not parts.path.startswith(prefix):
+            return None
+        path = unquote(parts.path[len(prefix):])
+    return path if _is_safe_object_path(path) else None
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(source: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    header, sep, encoded = source.partition(",")
+    if not sep or not header.lower().startswith("data:image/") or not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+        return None
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=False)
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(source: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Loads image bytes from a data: URL or our storage; never over the network
+    to a user-chosen address."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    if source[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_url(source)
+    path = storage_path_from_source(source)
+    if path is None:
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(path)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: missing.txt in the ZIP and an
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+
+
+def _store(name, data):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})[name] = data
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    ).json()
+    for order, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode["id"], "cut_order": order, "image_path": path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode["id"]
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+def _mixed_episode(client, h):
+    _store("cuts/m/ok.png", PNG)
+    _store("cuts/m/broken.png", b"not an image")
+    return _episode(client, h, [
+        "cuts/m/ok.png",                       # 1 ok
+        None,                                  # 2 no image yet
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/",      # 3 refused address
+        "cuts/m/broken.png",                   # 4 cannot be loaded
+        "cuts/m/does-not-exist.png",           # 5 cannot be loaded
+        DATA_URL,                              # 6 ok
+    ])
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = _export(client, h, _mixed_episode(client, h), "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        names = zf.namelist()
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4", "5"]
+    assert sorted(n for n in names if n != "missing.txt") == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_06.png"]
+
+
+def test_webtoon_sends_missing_cuts_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = _export(client, h, _mixed_episode(client, h), "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_header_and_no_missing_txt(client, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/all/one.png", PNG)
+    r = _export(client, h, _episode(client, h, ["cuts/all/one.png", DATA_URL]), fmt)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+            assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+            assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_readable_cross_origin(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _store("cuts/c/one.png", PNG)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/c/one.png", None])
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["access-control-expose-headers"].lower()

+"""The backend must never request an image address a user can set; only
+data: URLs and objects in our own storage are loaded."""

+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+INTERNAL_URLS = [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:8000/internal",
+    "https://intranet.example.com/secret.png",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+    "gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO",
+]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    attempts = []
+
+    def refuse_request(self, method, url, *a, **kw):
+        attempts.append(url)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend requested {url}")
+
+    def refuse_connect(self, address, *a, **kw):
+        attempts.append(address)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend connected to {address}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", refuse_request)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", refuse_connect)
+    return attempts
+
+
+def _store(name, data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})[name] = data
+
+
+def _storage_url(name):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    return f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{name}"
+
+

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", INTERNAL_URLS)
+def test_loader_refuses_other_addresses(no_network, url):

+    assert no_network == []

+def _episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    episode = episode.json()
+    cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode["id"], "cut_order": 1})
+    assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode["id"]

+ * Reads the cut numbers an export left out from its `X-Missing-Cuts` header

+ */
+export function getMissingCuts(headers: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
+  const raw = headers?.['x-missing-cuts'];
+  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return null;
+  const cuts = raw.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
+  return cuts.length > 0 ? cuts.join(', ') : null;
